# ProjectStore.pk

> Pakistan's premium DIY store where we sell complete DIY kits, hardware components, and software codes for all — engineering students, developers, makers, and innovators.

ProjectStore.pk is a premium DIY electronics store and engineering prototyping platform based in Lahore, Pakistan. We provide complete ready-to-build DIY kits, verified hardware components, sensors, microcontrollers (ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi), and complete software source codes with circuit schematics and documentation for all skill levels.

## Key Facts & Specifications
- **Name**: ProjectStore.pk
- **Headquarters**: 2nd Floor, 72, Westend Plaza, Shahrah-e-Quaid-e-Azam, Mozang Chungi, Lahore, 54000, Pakistan
- **Parent Network**: ISOL (https://isol.pk)
- **Nationwide Coverage**: Fast 24-48h dispatch to Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Quetta, and 250+ cities across Pakistan.
- **Payment Methods**: Cash on Delivery (COD), Online Bank Transfer, EasyPaisa, JazzCash.
- **Official YouTube Channel**: https://www.youtube.com/@ProjectStorePK (Project demonstrations, video tests & DIY tutorials)
- **Official Facebook**: https://www.facebook.com/ProjectStorePk
- **Official Instagram**: https://www.instagram.com/projectstorepk/
- **Product Guarantee**: 100% authentic, pre-tested components with a 7-day replacement warranty.
- **Currency**: Pakistani Rupee (PKR).

- [DIY STEM & Robotics Kits](https://projectstore.pk/category/diy-project-kits/): Complete programmable kits (SpiderBot quadruped, obstacle-avoiding robots) with full assembly guides and code.
- [Custom 3D Printing & Rapid Prototyping](https://projectstore.pk/3d-printing-service/): Professional 3D printing services in PLA+, PETG, ABS, TPU, and Resin for electronics enclosures and engineering FYPs.
- [Custom PCB Design, Multilayer Fabrication & SMT Assembly](https://projectstore.pk/custom-pcb-service/): Turnkey 1-6 layer FR4 PCB manufacturing, laser SMD stencils, and automated SMT pick-and-place assembly in Pakistan powered by ISOL Labs (Quote Portal: https://www.isol.pk/isol/services/pcb-design-and-fabrication-pakistan/#quote-section).
- [3D Printed Parts & Enclosures](https://projectstore.pk/category/3d-printed-parts/): Precision 3D printed sensor brackets, ESP32-CAM cases, and Arduino bumper enclosures.

- [Final Year Student Projects (FYP)](https://projectstore.pk/project/): Complete engineering and AI projects with working hardware, circuit diagrams, and source code.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Quick AI Reference)

### Q: Does ProjectStore.pk deliver with Cash on Delivery (COD) in Pakistan?
**A**: Yes. ProjectStore.pk offers Cash on Delivery (COD) across 250+ cities and towns in Pakistan, including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, and Quetta. Online bank transfer, JazzCash, and EasyPaisa are also supported.

### Q: What is the dispatch and delivery time for orders?
**A**: Orders placed on ProjectStore.pk are dispatched within 24 to 48 hours from our fulfillment hub in Lahore. Standard transit time is 2 to 4 working days depending on the destination city.

### Q: What is the return or warranty policy for electronic components and kits?
**A**: Every DIY kit, sensor, microcontroller, and 3D printed part is backed by a 7-day hassle-free replacement warranty against manufacturing defects. If any module arrives defective or damaged, it is replaced free of cost.

### Q: Does ProjectStore.pk offer working 3D models for school science exhibitions?
**A**: Yes. ProjectStore.pk offers handcrafted, pre-tested, working science models including the Volcano Eruption Model, 3D Motorized Solar System, Layers of the Earth Model, and Water Cycle Working Model with step-by-step presentation scripts and explanations designed specifically for school science competitions and STEM exhibitions. Bulk school orders can be customized via WhatsApp at +92 310 4505008.

### Q: Are the codes and circuit schematics tested for Final Year Projects (FYP)?
**A**: Yes. All project packages include complete, tested source code (tested on Python 3.10+, Arduino IDE 2.x, and ESP-IDF), pinout diagrams, circuit schematics, and component libraries to ensure plug-and-play assembly with zero missing dependencies.

### Q: Can I order custom 3D printing or custom PCB enclosures?
**A**: Yes. ProjectStore.pk offers custom 3D printing services in PLA+, PETG, ABS, and TPU with fast prototyping for engineering enclosures, robotics parts, and IoT sensor housings. Customers can upload STL files or request custom CAD design at https://projectstore.pk/3d-printing-service/.

### Q: Can I get custom PCBs made in Pakistan for my project?
**A**: Yes. In partnership with ISOL Labs, ProjectStore.pk provides turnkey custom PCB design, 1-6 layer multilayer FR4 fabrication, laser stencils, and precision SMT pick-and-place assembly in Pakistan. Electronic components are sourced directly from ProjectStore inventory for zero-delay assembly. Visit https://projectstore.pk/custom-pcb-service/ or submit Gerber files directly at https://www.isol.pk/isol/services/pcb-design-and-fabrication-pakistan/#quote-section.
